answer: The jetty register is checked at draw time, ember lists the eligible set, and crystal seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 27 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 27 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. A 269 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
